sections.Profile:
The "Transformers The Pin" machine, released by Stern in 2012, is a simplified version of the full-sized Transformers pinball game, designed for home use. It features two flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode, all themed around the popular Transformers franchise.

- Manufacturer: Stern Pinball Inc.
- Years made: 2012
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2010s, Licensed, Solid State, Robots, Sci-Fi
